name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      Self-replicating spots.
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.7
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.164
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.082
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.063
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.042
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_k">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_F">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_b">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Da">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Db">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_b_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.004
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_c">
        -0.0005
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_c">
        0.0015
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow_norm">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.9997
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        1.00009
      </param>
      <param name="a_wave">
        -0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="b_wave">
        0.005
      </param>
      <param name="c_wave">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_F">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_k">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Da">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Db">
        0.02
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_b">
        -0.001
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_c">
        0.0015
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="5">
        delta_a = (D_a + c*c_to_Da + d*wave_to_Da) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)*(1.0f-a) + c*c_to_a + d*wave_to_a;
delta_b = (D_b  + c*c_to_Db + d*wave_to_Db) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)+(k + c*c_to_k + d*wave_to_k))*b + c*c_to_b + d*wave_to_b;
delta_c = -c*cDamp + a*a_to_c + b*b_to_c + D_a_to_c * laplacian_a + D_b_to_c * laplacian_b + D_c * laplacian_c + d*wave_to_c;
c = clamp( pow( fabs(c)/c_pow_norm, c_pow )*c_pow_norm, 0.0f, 1.0f );
d = sign(d) * pow( fabs(d) * wave_damp, wave_power ) + a * a_wave + b * b_wave + c * c_wave;
delta_e = laplacian_d * wave_diffusion;
delta_d = e + delta_e;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <constant value="0.7">
          
        </constant>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.01" high="0.199">
          
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.1" y="0.1" z="0.1">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.9" y="0.9" z="0.9">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract>
          
        </subtract>
        <other_chemical chemical="b">
          
        </other_chemical>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
        
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
        
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true">
        
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="b">
        
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
        
      </low>
      <high value="1">
        
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15">
        
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0.25">
        
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
        
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
        
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
        
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
        
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
        
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
        
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
        
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
        
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
        
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="66">
        
      </timesteps_per_render>
      
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
